ai.title: Simaero plans to add more simulators, tap local engg talent in India: CEO
ai.description: French firm Simaero will invest 200 million euros in India over ten years. The company plans to expand its aviation training facility in Gurugram. It aims to develop local engineering talent for simulator technology services. Simaero expects to operate four to six simulators by 2029. Artificial intelligence will enhance operational efficiency and learning experiences.
ai.title_cn: Simaero计划增加更多模拟器，挖掘印度当地的engg人才：首席执行官
ai.description_cn: 法国公司Simaero将在十年内在印度投资2亿欧元。该公司计划扩大其位于古鲁格拉姆的航空培训设施。它旨在培养模拟器技术服务的本地工程人才。Simaero预计到2029年将运营四到六个模拟器。人工智能将提高运营效率和学习体验。
